{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check basic shape and dtypes
print(f"Shape: {df.shape}")
print(f"Columns: {list(df.columns)}")
print(f"Dtypes:\n{df.dtypes}")

# Check for sentinel values in biomarker_baseline
sentinel_count = (df['biomarker_baseline'] == -999).sum()
print(f"Number of -999 values in biomarker_baseline: {sentinel_count}")

# Check for duplicate patient_id
print(f"Number of unique patient_id: {df['patient_id'].nunique()}")
print(f"Total rows: {len(df)}")
print(f"Duplicate patient_id count: {len(df) - df['patient_id'].nunique()}")

# Check for re-testing (multiple sample_seq per patient)
duplicates = df.groupby('patient_id').size() > 1
dup_count = duplicates.sum()
print(f"Number of patients with multiple sample_seq: {dup_count}")

# Check arm distribution
df['arm'].value_counts()"}
